info.about: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 is a 2001 skateboarding video game and the third installment in the Tony Hawk's series. It was published by Activision under the Activision O2 label in 2001 for the PlayStation, PlayStation 2, Game Boy Color and GameCube.
info.trivia: Like the PlayStation version, the N64 port runs on the older Pro Skater 2 engine.
info.why: It was the final official Nintendo 64 release and the only game released for the system in 2002, three months after the console was discontinued.
